reply.text:
I appreciate the question, but I need to be straight with you: there's no fast way to get abs, and at 13 you're still growing. What matters right now is building the habit of training consistently, eating enough to fuel that growth, and letting your body do its thing.

Abs show when you have muscle under the skin and low enough body fat, but forcing either one at your age can backfire. Train hard, eat well, stay active, and trust the process. What kind of training are you doing now?
